sentences.en: We would appreciate it if you grant us this concession.
sentences.zh: 我们希望你们能给予我们这个让步。

sentences.en: Please let us know your conditions for making the concession.
sentences.zh: 请告知我们在做出让步时需要满足什么条件。

sentences.en: We believe that you will be able to make a price concession.
sentences.zh: 我们相信你们会愿意在价格上给予一些优惠。

senses.zh: 承认, 允许妥协, 让步特许权形容词:concessional

mnemonic: 联想记忆：con（共同）+cess（行走，前进）+ion→要想大家共同进步，必须都做出让步→让步
